extracted.intended_audience: California voters and prospective voters (individuals seeking key election dates and deadlines)
extracted.subtask_description: Lists key dates, registration deadlines, vote-by-mail replacement guidance, and completed-ballot delivery/postmark rules for California's 2026 Primary and General elections. Intended to tell voters when and how to register and return ballots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Election date and poll hours
rubrics_metrics.description: June 2, 2026 — Primary Election; 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary voter registration deadline (and conditional registration)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can “conditionally” register and vote at your county elections office after the 15-day voter registration deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary replacement vote-by-mail ballot application recommended date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the recommended date for submitting a replacement Vote-by-Mail Ballot Application (i.e., request a replacement ballot ahead of the election).

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary completed ballots (including vote-by-mail) delivery/postmark rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Personally delivered ballots: Must be delivered by close of polls on June 2, 2026; Mailed ballots: Must be postmarked on or before June 2, 2026, and received by your county elections office no later than June 9, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If delivering in person, ballots must arrive by polls closing. If mailed, both the postmark-by date and a county receipt-by date apply (postmark by election day; county must receive by the specified receipt deadline).

rubrics_metrics.name: General Election date and poll hours
rubrics_metrics.description: November 3, 2026 — General Election; 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

rubrics_metrics.name: General voter registration deadline (and conditional registration)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can “conditionally” register and vote at your county elections office after the 15-day voter registration deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: General replacement vote-by-mail ballot application recommended date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the recommended date for submitting a replacement Vote-by-Mail Ballot Application prior to the General Election.

rubrics_metrics.name: General completed ballots (including vote-by-mail) delivery/postmark rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Personally delivered ballots: Must be delivered by close of polls on November 3, 2026; Mailed ballots: Must be postmarked on or before November 3, 2026, and received by your county elections office no later than November 10, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same delivery vs. mail distinction as the Primary: in-person delivery must reach by polls close; mailed ballots require correct postmark and must be received by the later receipt deadline.
